question_h2: Are recurrent flower-colour transition edges concentrated where independently frozen macroclimate changes more strongly?

hierarchical_role.if_h1_does_not_pass: retain H2 only as a labelled diagnostic with no climate-mechanism claim

environment_source.provider: WorldClim 2.1 10 arc-minute bioclimatic variables, aggregated in the pre-colour atlas environment freeze

h1_grid_aggregation.target_grid: the exact H1 equal-area longitude by sin(latitude) grid
h1_grid_aggregation.source_cell_assignment: assign each frozen climate-grid centroid to the H1 equal-area cell containing that centroid
h1_grid_aggregation.climate_summary_per_h1_cell: arithmetic mean of each BIO variable across source cells; source grid cells are equal-area
h1_grid_aggregation.realm_and_biome_summary: deterministic modal label; exact count ties resolved lexicographically
h1_grid_aggregation.standardization: z-score each BIO variable across all H1 cells with complete four-variable climate coverage, before any flower-colour join

primary_edge_predictor.name: multivariate_climate_distance
primary_edge_predictor.definition: sqrt(mean((zBIO_j_i - zBIO_j_j)^2)) across BIO1, BIO4, BIO12 and BIO15
primary_edge_predictor.directional_hypothesis: larger climate distance predicts larger recurrent-boundary persistence

primary_test.statistic: opportunity-weighted Pearson correlation between persistence and multivariate climate distance
primary_test.supported_edges: edges with H1 opportunity > 0 and finite complete climate on both cells
primary_test.null: reuse each of the same 999 H1 within-species morph permutations; recompute edge persistence under the frozen H1 sampling plan and correlate with the fixed climate-distance vector

driver_decomposition.role: secondary decomposition after the single multivariate primary test
driver_decomposition.null: same matched H1 permutation persistence maps
driver_decomposition.multiplicity: Holm family-wise correction across the four BIO axes

claim_ceiling: A passing hierarchical H1 followed by H2 supports concordance between recurrent flower-colour transition geography and macroclimate contrast. It does not by itself identify selection, adaptation, pigment biochemistry, pollinator causation, or a unique climate variable as causal.
